headline:
زي Astro Bot مجانًا
في Rayman Legends Retold
label: رسمي
note: PlayStation Blog 13:01Z (read in full): Rayman Legends Retold comes to PS5 and PS5 Pro on 3 Dec with a PS5-exclusive Astro Bot costume, free on the first visit to the tailor Victor Velour; a collaboration of Ubisoft Milan, Ubisoft Montpellier and Team Asobi. Costume image: Sony's own blog image. Rayman's usual look and gameplay: Ubisoft's reveal trailer (Steam). Comparison: his usual look, then the costume, hard cuts; trailer music under it.
